mn99:20.6: gahaṭṭho hi bho gotama mahattho mahākicco mahādhikaraṇo mahāsamārambho na satataṃ samitaṃ tapassī hoti …

mn99:20.14: yeme bho gotama brāhmaṇā pañca dhamme paññapenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāya imāhaṃ pañca dhamme pabbajitesu bahulaṃ samanupassāmi appaṃ gahaṭṭhesūti.
mn99:21.1: ye te māṇava brāhmaṇā pañca dhamme paññapenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāya cittassāhaṃ ete parikkhāre vadāmi
mn99:21.2: yadidaṃ cittaṃ averaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ tassa bhāvanāya.
mn99:21.4: so saccavādimhīti labhati atthavedaṃ labhati dhammavedaṃ labhati dhammūpasañhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ
mn99:21.5: yantaṃ kusalūpasañhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ cittassāhaṃ etaṃ parikkhāraṃ vadāmi
mn99:21.6: yadidaṃ cittaṃ averaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ tassa bhāvanāya.
mn99:21.11: so cāgabahulomhīti labhati atthavedaṃ labhati dhammavedaṃ labhati dhammūpasañhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ
mn99:21.12: yantaṃ kusalūpasañhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ cittassāhaṃ etaṃ parikkhāraṃ vadāmi
mn99:21.13: yadidaṃ cittaṃ averaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ tassa bhāvanāya.
mn99:21.14: ye te māṇava brāhmaṇā pañca dhamme paññapenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāya cittassāhaṃ ete parikkhāre vadāmi
mn99:21.15: yadidaṃ cittaṃ averaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ tassa bhāvanāyāti.
mn99:22.1: evaṃ vutte subho māṇavo todeyyaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn99:22.3: samaṇo gotamo brahmānaṃ sahabyatāya maggaṃ pajānātīti.
mn99:22.5: āsanne ito naḷakāragāmo nayito dūre naḷakāragāmoti.
mn99:22.6: evaṃ bho gotama āsanne ito naḷakāragāmo nayito dūre naḷakāragāmoti.
mn99:22.7: taṃ kiṃ maññasi māṇava idha khvassa puriso naḷakāragāme jāta vaḍḍho
mn99:22.8: tamenaṃ naḷakāragāmato tāvadeva apasakkaṃ naḷakāragāmassa maggaṃ puccheyya
mn99:22.9: siyā nu kho māṇava tassa purisassa naḷakāragāme jāta vaḍḍhassa naḷakāragāmassa maggaṃ puṭṭhassa dandhāyitattaṃ vā vitthāyitattaṃ vāti.
mn99:22.12: assa hi bho gotama purisassa naḷakāragāme jāta vaḍḍhassa sabbāneva naḷakāragāmassa maggāni suviditānīti.
mn99:22.13: siyā na kho māṇava tassa purisassa naḷakāragāme jāta vaḍḍhassa naḷakāragāmassa maggaṃ puṭṭhassa dandhāyitattaṃ vā vitthāyitattaṃ vā na tveva tathāgatassa brahmalokaṃ vā brahmalokagāminiṃ vā paṭipadaṃ puṭṭhassa dandhāyitattaṃ vā vitthāyitattaṃ vā
mn99:22.14: brahmānañcāhaṃ māṇava pajānāmi brahmalokañca brahmalokagāminiñca paṭipadaṃ yathāpaṭipanno ca brahmalokaṃ upapanno tañca pajānāmīti.
mn99:23.2: samaṇo gotamo brahmānaṃ sahabyatāya maggaṃ desetīti
mn99:23.3: sādhu me bhavaṃ gotamo brahmānaṃ sahabyatāya maggaṃ desetūti.
mn99:23.4: tenahi māṇava suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmīti.
mn99:23.5: evaṃ bhoti kho subho māṇavo todeyyaputto bhagavato paccassosi.
mn99:24.1: katamo ca māṇava brahmānaṃ sahabyatāya maggo
mn99:24.2: idha māṇava bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbatthatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati
mn99:24.3: evaṃ bhāvitāya kho māṇava mettāya cetovimuttiyā yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatrāvasissati na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhati
mn99:24.4: seyyathāpi māṇava balavā saṅkhadhamo appa kasireneva cātuddisā viññāpeyya
mn99:24.5: evameva kho māṇava evaṃ bhāvitāya mettāya cetovimuttiyā yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatrāvasissati na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhati
mn99:24.6: ayampi kho māṇava brahmānaṃ sahabyatāya maggo.
mn99:25-27.1: puna caparaṃ māṇava bhikkhu karuṇāsahagatena cetasā …
mn99:25-27.3: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbatthatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati
mn99:25-27.4: evaṃ bhāvitāya kho māṇava upekkhāya cetovimuttiyā yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatrāvasissati na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhati
mn99:25-27.5: seyyathāpi māṇava balavā saṅkhadhamo appa kasireneva cātuddisā viññāpeyya
mn99:25-27.6: evameva kho māṇava evaṃ bhāvitāya upekkhāya cetovimuttiyā yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatrāvasissati na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhati
mn99:25-27.7: ayampi kho māṇava brahmānaṃ sahabyatāya maggoti.
mn99:28.1: evaṃ vutte subho māṇavo todeyyaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn99:28.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama
mn99:28.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evameva bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
mn99:28.4: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
mn99:28.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgataṃ
mn99:28.6: handa cadāni mayaṃ bho gotama gacchāma
mn99:29.2: atha kho subho māṇavo todeyyaputto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
mn99:30.1: tena kho pana samayena jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo sabbasetena valavābhirathena sāvatthiyā niyyāti divādivassa.
mn99:30.2: addasā kho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo subhaṃ māṇavaṃ todeyyaputtaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ
mn99:30.5: ito hi kho ahaṃ bho āgacchāmi samaṇassa gotamassa santikāti.
mn99:30.6: taṃ kiṃ maññasi bhavaṃ bhāradvājo samaṇassa gotamassa paññāveyyattiyaṃ paṇḍito maññeti
mn99:30.7: ko cāhambho ko ca samaṇassa gotamassa paññāveyyattiyaṃ jānissāmi
mn99:30.8: sopi nūnassa tādisova yo samaṇassa gotamassa paññāveyyattiyaṃ jāneyyāti.
mn99:30.9: uḷārāya khalu bhavaṃ bhāradvājo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pasaṃsāya pasaṃsatīti.
mn99:30.10: ko cāhambho ko ca samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pasaṃsissāmi
mn99:30.11: pasatthappasattho ca bhavaṃ gotamo seṭṭho devamanussānaṃ
mn99:30.12: ye came bho brāhmaṇā pañca dhamme paññapenti puññassa kiriyāya kusalassa ārādhanāya
mn99:30.13: cittasseva samaṇo gotamo ete parikkhāre vadeti
mn99:30.14: yadidaṃ cittaṃ averaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ tassa bhāvanāyāti.
mn99:31.1: evaṃ vutte jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo sabbasetā valavābhirathā orohitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā udānaṃ udānesi
mn99:31.2: lābhā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa suladdhaṃ rañño pasenadissa kosalassa
mn99:31.3: yassa vijite tathāgato viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddhoti.
